messages:
maria: Quick sync — I'm updating the pricing & usage analytics guide. Need a short example for per-customer tier attribution (how to compute daily billable tokens per tier) and a migration snippet for SDK v2 header rename (old: X-Redwood-Org -> new: X-RW-Org). Also want a dashboard panel query for billable_tokens_by_tier and a tiny SQL example. Tagging @aj for query help and @kevin for rate-limit wording.
aj: Ack. Which dataset should we assume? Hosted only or Dedicated too?
maria: Hosted + Dedicated. For Dedicated include a note about per-reserved-capacity metering (use capacity_owner_id). Example dataset: table "usage_events" with columns timestamp, org_id, customer_tier, tokens, route, reserved_capacity_id, burst_covered_tokens.
aj: Got it. For Grafana/Prometheus metric we usually do something like:
```
sum by (customer_tier) (increase(redwood_tokens_total{route=~".*"}[24h]))
```
You can use label_replace if the tier is in a different label: `label_replace(..., "customer_tier", "$1", "tier_label", "(.*)")`

kevin: Should we surface burst credits separately? I think yes — show formula: `effective_billable_tokens = tokens - burst_covered_tokens` and note we clamp negatives to 0.
sam: Edge-case to call out: routed fallback to cheaper model. Docs should show both raw token counts and an example cost multiplier column (model_cost_mult) so customers can reproduce the billed cost.
maria: OK will include both columns and a short paragraph about fallbacks. Drafting SDK v2 curl snippet — check header name: new header is X-RW-Org, X-Redwood-Org is deprecated.
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $RW_KEY" \
     -H "X-RW-Org: org_123" \
     -d '{"input":"hi"}' \
     https://api.redwoodinference.com/v1/generate
```
aj: LGTM. Also suggest adding this minimal SQL for data teams:
```
SELECT customer_tier,
       SUM(tokens) AS raw_tokens,
       SUM(GREATEST(tokens - COALESCE(burst_covered_tokens,0),0)) AS effective_billable_tokens
FROM usage_events
WHERE timestamp >= current_date - interval '1 day'
GROUP BY customer_tier;
```
kevin: tiny nit — mention that for Dedicated, usage rows may have reserved_capacity_id and you should join on capacity_owner_id to roll up to org-level metrics.
docs-bot: PR opened by @maria: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/912 — reviewers: @aj @kevin
maria: Thanks all! I'll push the changes and ask @aj for a quick pass. If no objections I'll merge tomorrow morning. :thumbsup:
